verdict.rationale: Time logging against tasks and projects is a fair question for an issue and project tracker like Linear, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents logging, recording, or reporting time spent on issues or projects. The closest material is planning features (initiatives, statuses, priorities, project target dates) and generic API/SDK building blocks, none of which is time logging.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects
